    Simulated batch fermentations

    Source: R/data.R
    fermentation_sim.Rd

    Simulated data. Biomass and glucose time courses from three batch bioreactors with different starting glucose (10, 20 and 30 g/l), generated from the exact solution of the Monod model with \(\mu_{max}\) = 0.55 per hour, Ks = 0.4 g/l, yield 0.48 g/g and starting biomass 0.08 g/l, with 4 percent multiplicative noise on biomass and 0.25 g/l additive noise on glucose.

    Usage

    fermentation_sim

    Format

    A tibble with 45 rows and 4 columns:

    reactor

    Reactor ("R1", "R2", "R3").

    time_h

    Time (hours).

    biomass_g_l

    Dry cell weight (g/l).

    glucose_g_l

    Residual glucose (g/l).

    Source

    Simulated with a fixed seed in data-raw/make_data.R.

    Examples

    fermentation_sim
#> # A tibble: 45 × 4
#>    reactor time_h biomass_g_l glucose_g_l
#>    <chr>    <dbl>       <dbl>       <dbl>
#>  1 R1           0      0.0877      10.1  
#>  2 R1           1      0.129        9.66 
#>  3 R1           2      0.224        9.61 
#>  4 R1           3      0.384        9.35 
#>  5 R1           4      0.636        9.04 
#>  6 R1           5      1.08         8.05 
#>  7 R1           6      1.94         6.42 
#>  8 R1           7      3.11         3.98 
#>  9 R1           8      4.80         0    
#> 10 R1           9      5.33         0.318
#> # ℹ 35 more rows
